svg.title: When may a Codex pane tail a rollout file?
svg.desc: A pane tails a rollout only with proof. Resume starts from an exact thread and follows a fork only on lineage overlap. A fresh session needs an exact proxy thread identity or a unique causal prompt match. Ambiguity blocks the file instead of guessing.

svg.text: Blue: Agent Code · Gray / dashed border: external · Amber: checks and cautions
